instructions: Use only the supplied authorized observations and public identities. Distinguish a claim, an observed time, an estimated interval and an independently verified alibi.
Respect canonical time zones, source timestamps, work schedules and travel constraints. Preserve planned conflicts as attributed claims.
A suspect profile must not label a person guilty or innocent using private generator knowledge.
contract: Preserve supplied person, event and source IDs and canonical timestamps.
Support every verified alibi with an exact excerpt from a readable, reachable source.
Do not promote absence of a record into proof that a person was elsewhere.
positiveExample: The witness estimates arrival between 18:10 and 18:20; the authenticated access export independently records 18:14.
negativeExample: The author changes the access time to fit a suspect's statement and marks the alibi verified without a source.
criteria: Chronology is compatible with recorded precision and travel duration.
Public timeline does not expose private criminal acts.
Contradictory accounts remain attributable and answerable through delivered evidence.
